rules.text: If the plotted blue markers encode reported case counts by their vertical positions against the y-axis labeled "Count", and the left-to-right x-axis positions represent the displayed reporting progression, then a line whose later-positioned endpoint is higher on the page than its earlier-positioned endpoint indicates a rising reported-case trajectory. If the routing labels are intended to correspond to the named trajectory directions, that trajectory supports the rising-case escalation follow-up route.
rules.conditions: Assumes the y-axis's upward screen direction encodes greater counts, the horizontal order encodes reporting progression, and the route names are semantically matched to the observed trajectory.
